subject: HQ Immersion Session — scheduling & logistics
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@avalonbio.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@avalonbio.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Onsite immersion at Redwood HQ Dec 12-13?

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Avalon execs want an in-person immersion at Redwood HQ to see the dedicated pipeline and run a small integration workshop. Are you available to host the team on Tue-Wed, Dec 12-13? We'll bring 6 folks (2 execs, 3 engineers, 1 security lead). A few logistical asks up front:

- We'll need visitor badges and escort for the lab rooms.
- Our security lead (Nikolai Ivanov) needs to review SOC2 evidence prior to visit; can we send that?
- One attendee needs a visitor visa letter — can Redwood provide an invitation on company letterhead?
- Would you be able to arrange a shuttle from SFO (around 8:30 AM) and back? Preferably two-way.

If those dates won't work, let me know alternative windows the week after. We can sign an NDA if needed — Priya is on copy.

Appreciate it,
Sam
-- 
Sam Lee
Director, Technical Programs
Avalon Bio
sam.lee@avalonbio.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@avalonbio.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@avalonbio.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite immersion at Redwood HQ Dec 12-13?

Hi Sam — great to hear Avalon can make an in-person run. Dec 12-13 is tentatively available. A few quick notes and next steps: 

1) NDA & SOC2: I can send the DocuSign NDA right away and loop in Security. Karthik, could you confirm the SOC2 packet availability and point of contact for Nikolai?

2) Badging & Escort: Jordan will own badges and the physical escort for lab areas. Jordan — please prepare a badge list template and confirm escort window for both days.

3) Shuttle & Arrival: We do not operate a dedicated shuttle, but we can book a private shuttle vendor (cost would be passed through). If Avalon prefers, we can provide clear parking instructions and rideshare directions. Sam — do you want us to secure the shuttle? If yes, please confirm pickup at SFO at 08:30 and return at 17:30 for both days.

4) Visa letter: happy to provide an invitation letter on Redwood letterhead. Nikolai: please send full legal name + passport number + home address for the letter.

I'll start the NDA and propose a calendar hold for Dec 12 08:30–17:30.

Cheers,
Monica

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@avalonbio.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@avalonbio.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 18:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite immersion at Redwood HQ Dec 12-13?

Sam / Monica — I can get the SOC2 extracts and the controls mapping to you by EOD Monday. Nikolai: could you confirm which control areas you want to see (S3 encryption, logging/alerts, incident response evidence, or full Type II report)? I can redact anything that is vendor-sensitive.

Also: for the workshop run-of-show, are you planning active model hosting (we'll reserve a small Dedicated pool for you) or will this be purely demo/slide-driven? If you need live workloads, tell me approximate qps and sequence lengths so we can size the slot.

-Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <p.desai@avalonbio.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@avalonbio.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 07:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite immersion at Redwood HQ Dec 12-13?

Thanks — quick clarifications from Avalon side: 

- We will need the NDA by EOD Monday so our legal can review. Please send DocuSign link.
- Shuttle: please secure the shuttle; we will reimburse the vendor invoice. Confirm approx. cost if possible.
- Catering: can Redwood handle a simple working lunch both days (sandwiches + vegetarian/gluten-free options)? Budget up to $25/head/day.
- Badge list: I'll circulate names once the NDA is signed. Nikolai will provide passport info on Thursday for the visa letter.

Also, one of our engineers (Nikolai) is flying from Russia and asked whether Redwood can provide a letter for expedited visa processing.

Appreciate fast turnaround — we need travel approvals by Tue morning.

Best,
Priya
--
Priya Desai
Programs Manager, Partnerships
Avalon Bio
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@avalonbio.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@avalonbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 09:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite immersion at Redwood HQ Dec 12-13?

Hi all — locking this down from ops side. Quick updates: 

- NDA: Monica has sent the DocuSign (link below). Please sign and return; legal review should take <24 hours.
- Badges: attached is a template (badge_list_avalon_dec12.csv). Once you send names + DOB + passport (for Nikolai), we'll push final badges to security.
- Rooms: We reserved Conference C (capacity 10) for the workshop and the adjacent lab bay for a hands-on demo. If you prefer the larger Boardroom A for executive Q&A, we can swap — let me know.
- Shuttle: I spoke with our vendor; estimate $650/day for a 12-seat round-trip shuttle to SFO (including driver). I'll book upon confirmation; vendor requires a 50% deposit.
- Catering: catering is confirmed — sandwich platters, one GF/vegan box per attendee per day. Budget aligned.

Attachments (sent): run_of_show_v2.pdf, badge_list_avalon_dec12.csv, redwood_hq_map.pdf

DocuSign NDA: https://docusign.com/avalon/redwood-nda-AV-2028
Calendar placeholder: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=avalon-immersion-dec12

If the shuttle works for Avalon, I'll issue an invoice for deposit and we can finalize.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan Blake
Operations Coordinator | Redwood Inference
